title: chamaesium novem-jugum var. delavayi
intro: Chamaesium novem-jugum var. delavayi, commonly known as Chamaesiphon delavayi or Chamaesium delavayi, is a plant species in the family Apiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health issues. The health benefits of Chamaesium novem-jugum var. delavayi include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which can help to soothe skin irritations, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory effects.
